events.text: The beacon split. And so did we. I can still hear you. Find a way to light yours; I'll try to light mine.
The beacon that split you still exists in both worlds. Relight yours. Help them relight theirs. Bring the two flames into sync.

A sluice gate holds the stream back. The ford and the sand path lie under water.
